# 长中文通用常识文 — 猫推东西行为的科学解释

## 字数参考：约 420 字

猫为什么总爱把桌上的东西推下去

segments.narration: 猫为什么总爱把桌上的，东西推下去，这个行为背后其实有深，刻的进化与心理原因，首先，猫的脚垫非常敏感，上面分布着大量的触觉，感受器，当它们触碰物体时。
segments.visual_desc: stickman reaching upward and pushing a cup toward the table edge

beats.3-7s: slow push-in to a medium shot as the stickman turns side-on
beats.7-10s: stickman crouches and places a small cup on the table edge, camera holds low

action_beats.3-7s: slow push-in to a medium shot as the stickman turns side-on
action_beats.7-10s: stickman crouches and places a small cup on the table edge, camera holds low

segments.visual_state_start: white background with a centered stickman standing in a neutral start pose
segments.visual_state_end: stickman reaching upward and pushing a cup toward the table edge

segments.narration: 实际上是在用脚垫探测，物体的质地，温度和移动性，轻轻一推，如果物体会滚动或发出，声响，就说明它可能是活物或，值得追踪的目标，这是猫科动物刻在基因。

segments.narration: 里的狩猎本能，在野外，小猫需要通过推，抓，拍来学习如何捕捉猎物，其次，高处跌落产生的声音和，运动轨迹，对猫的神经系统是强烈，刺激，物体坠落时的抛物线。

segments.visual_state_end: stickman crouching low and pressing one palm flat against the ground

segments.narration: 碰撞声，滚动节奏，都会触发猫大脑中的奖，赏回路，即使没有真正的猎物，这种，模拟狩猎，也能释放多巴胺，让猫感到满足和愉悦，最后，猫咪敏锐地观察到。

stitching_guide: 1. Generate each clip independently in Google Flow using the standalone prompt above.
2. Name clips in sequence: clip_00.mp4, clip_01.mp4, ..., clip_05.mp4.
3. Check first/last frame continuity at every cut: the ending visual state of clip i must match the opening state of clip i+1.
5. Or use Hevi's video-assemble step to concatenate the clip files in order.
6. Keep audio (voiceover + BGM) continuous across cuts; if using separate audio, crossfade 0.5s at each junction.
voice_music_continuity: Voiceover language: Chinese (default for Hevi users).
One frozen narrator voice profile for the whole video (identity/age, accent, timbre, register, resonance, texture, delivery, pace, recording treatment). Do not change voice per clip.
Voiceover is audio-only: no speech bubbles, no dialogue boxes, no visible text in the generated clips.
BGM: clip 1 establishes the musical theme; clips 2-N continue the identical BGM seamlessly (same tempo, instrumentation, mood).
SFX: synchronized crisp SFX on physical character actions.
Word-count scaling: ~20-25 English words or ~45-60 Chinese characters per 10s clip.
